data_source: 909 sessions across 4 agents, ~15.5h autonomous operation (2026-03-11 to 2026-03-12)

gate_poll.description: Check if a gate resolved — minimal context, no Claude invocation needed

sync_light.description: Git pull, check transport, light reasoning, no commits

sync_substantive.description: Full sync with commits, edits, transport message drafting

deep.description: Full interactive-equivalent session — multi-file edits, complex reasoning

notes: Costs estimated from JSONL session sizes — actual API costs may differ by ~30%
Cache hits reduce input token costs significantly (up to 90% reduction)
Observatory burns disproportionately due to high deep-session count
gate_poll should not invoke Claude at all — purely mechanical HTTP check
